body:
Thank you for your submission.

Looking at the [License Inclusion Principles](https://github.com/spdx/license-list-XML/blob/main/DOCS/license-inclusion-principles.md), this license appears to be newly drafted with no actual substantial use. From a few quick searches in GitHub and elsewhere I am seeing no evidence of use by others, let alone substantial use. The SPDX License List is meant to capture licenses that are actually likely to be encountered, not for newly-drafted aspirational licenses.

If in the future your license receives significant and substantial community uptake, please feel free to resubmit it at that time for re-consideration. In the meantime I am marking this as not accepted and closing the issue.
